scientific_protocol: Existing protocol.json/R0-SCHEMA-1/R0-TRIAL-1/R1-CODE-1 unchanged; this prospectively makes implementation details explicit, never relaxes gates
progression: lexicographic23sessions; all baseline candidates first, then globally shared combined offset selected using development only, then family candidates; first session is smoke, first3independent patients small cohort, all9full cohort; any mandatory candidate/seed fails=>STOP immediately, no other fits or external access
optimization: Frozen fit_model:500iterations,ftol/gtol1e-5,bounds[-8,8],normalized likelihood plus ridge; no clipping, retries, increased budgets or selective seed exclusion

context.primary: Verify allowed-trial fixation[-6,-5],stimulus[-5,-3],maintenance[-3,0]. Use elapsed-bin start/duration and its square, current encoding/maintenance indicators, known scheduled event-onset pulse, set-size standardized from training metadata and gated to stimulus onset onward. Exclude correctness, response, probe match and future outcome fields embedded in event names.
context.position: (trialID-training minimum)/(training maximum-training minimum), frozen train endpoints; never derive scale from development/final trial extent
context.constant_columns: Retain only context columns with nonzero training range; mask fitted on training and unchanged for development/final; report nominal parameters and design rank
context.external: stimulus-onset[0,1)recognition epoch; same elapsed/event basis, no unsupported working-memory load/maintenance label, train-only constant-column mask; task difference explicit

selection.scope: One global hyperparameter configuration per baseline/model family, transferable to external session-local fitting; never per-session/final hyperparameter tuning
selection.seeds: Within each session/candidate retain all3seed results; choose smallest penalized TRAINING objective with seed order tie-break, never development-best seed
selection.mean: Equal-session within patient then equal-patient validation mean; same trials/units for every configuration
selection.one_SE: 10000fixed-seed20261011 hierarchical resamples:patients with replacement and whole-population trials within each retained session with replacement. SE=sample SD of resampled patient-weighted scores. Eligible candidates score>=best mean-bestSE; select lowest patient-weighted mean total nominal parameters, then larger ridge, then fixed configuration order. This keeps patient primary and trials whole.
selection.offset: Select combined GLM ridge with this one-SE rule across completed baseline grid; same trained combined offset in every family. Nulls refit this frozen combined configuration before family candidates.
selection.strongest_baseline: Highest development patient-weighted score across seed-resolved frozen baseline candidates, complexity/fixed-order tie break; freeze before external. Also report one-SE baseline selection, never choose a weaker comparator post hoc.
selection.best_model: Apply one-SE rule across completed family candidates; report selected-family configurations, frontier, uncertainty and strongest baseline. Development selection/inference exploratory and postselection-conditional.

statistics.Holm: six contrasts per dev and external:3family pairs+3vsstrongest baseline
statistics.session_CI: 10000whole-trial resamples; descriptive conditional uncertainty, not independent subjects
statistics.patient_CI: whole trials within all patient sessions, equal-session averages; descriptive

controls: independent permutation of bins within each trial/unit preserving its total
independent circular shifts per trial/unit:primary5..20bins,external5..9bins; no identity
within-trial rotate known task/time context by same admissible offsets; counts unchanged
nulls.refit: Frozen selected family configurations, strongest baseline and shared combined offset; all3seeds, choose training objective only. No retuning. Entire patient remains statistical unit. Failure in any mandatory null fit stops; all attempts retained.
nulls.report: All patient-mean paired-gain distributions; empirical upper-tail p=(1+exceedances)/(201), ties count; report null-type/family multiplicity explicitly, no shortcut from raw p to physical mechanism

external.before_spikes: Completed development/statistics/null gates, frozen configuration/feature/scoring/null manifest, independently source-supported observation coverage and pinned split hash
external.fit: Only60percent calibration train for local parameters and unit>=20spike mask; >=5hippocampal units/session and>=8patients. All frozen seeds, no model/hyperparameter selection from final.
external.final: Once after all preprocessing masks and parameter/seeds frozen. No final-bin/unit/session pruning based on scores or rates. Dedicated sealed accessor must enforce prerequisites and retain access ledger; data transport/feature acquisition boundaries audited before activation.
external.never: No primary oldtest, final tuning, neuron identity transfer or direct replication claim

scientific_verdict: INCONCLUSIVE until complete valid competition/nulls/independent assessment; DATA_INSUFFICIENT for cohort or observation support failure. Preferred label, if justified later, concerns predictive representations only, not physical hippocampal mechanisms.
STOP: Any frozen numerical/convergence/cohort/leakage/independence/required validation gate failure stops. Preserve all remaining requirements as NOT_EXECUTED, no threshold reduction and no R3. No engineering PASS substitutes for scientific gate.
